issue.body:
I'm sorry, but it looks like we hit another issue in the indent rule. It should pass, imho. eslint@1.7.2

```
indent: [2,2]
```

``` js
functionWithCallback(something,
                     function() {
  var error;
})
```

```
  3:3  error  Expected indentation of 23 space characters but found 2  indent
  4:1  error  Expected indentation of 21 space characters but found 0  indent
```

[Real code example code](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/0fc0902c21c9c9ed180e575f34b9b39366d57685/test/parallel/test-promises-unhandled-rejections.js#L238-L240).
